items.title: Asian Paints' board announces Rs 23/share dividend, sets June 23 as record date
items.description: Asian Paints Dividend: The company has fixed June 23, 2026, as the record date to determine shareholders eligible to receive the final dividend. Including the interim dividend of Rs 4.50 per share declared in November 2025, the total dividend payout for FY26 stands at Rs 27.50 per equity share.

items.title: Asian Paints Q4 Results: Net profit surges 69% YoY to Rs 1,172 crore, revenue rises 11%
items.description: Asian Paints announced strong Q4 FY26 results. Net profit surged 69% to Rs 1,172 crore. Revenue from operations grew 11% to Rs 9,228.46 crore. The company also declared a final dividend of Rs 23 per share. For the full year FY26, net profit rose 18% to Rs 4,325.35 crore. Management highlighted double-digit growth in decorative and industrial businesses.
